summary: Frontend-only test of the new Behance-style collapsible sidebar (AppShell.jsx), run with Playwright at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Admin, staff and owner accounts were used. Working: the floating rounded panel (272px wide, 16px radius, shadow); the header with logo, app name and collapse chevron; the profile card with the role in brand colour (rgb 224,0,0 = --primary). Search works: 'stu' shows only nav-students, and gibberish shows sidebar-search-empty. Academic year select works. Groups accounts/office/details toggle aria-expanded with the chevron. Active item has the tinted pill, the left bar and the filled icon. These links all navigate with correct titles: students, leads, attendance, messages, users, settings and overview. The theme toggle switches dark on and off, and sidebar-logout-btn goes to /login. Rail: data-collapsed=true at 80px, with tooltips on hover (e.g. 'Students'). The state persists after reload (sidebarRail=1). rail-search, rail-year and the topbar toggle all expand or collapse it, and nothing overflows. Badges: with a mocked unread-count of 12, the expanded pill shows '9+' and the rail shows a 10px dot. Staff sees a flat list: Overview, Messages, Students, My Leads, Attendance, Profile. Mobile: the drawer is 300px wide and full height at z-70, above the z-50 bottom nav. The element at the bottom is drawer-logout-btn. Everything can be reached by scrolling, a tap navigates and closes the drawer, there is no horizontal overflow, and drawer logout works. The tour step 'Navigation' (2 of 10) highlights nav-overview. The owner /platform console is unchanged. ONE REAL BUG: in rail mode the nav links lose most of their classes, so the icons are off-centre and the active pill is missing.

ui_bugs.issue: In the collapsed rail, every NavLink's class attribute is the SOURCE TEXT of the linkClass function. The actual class is the literal string '({ isActive }) => ["group relative ...'. Result: justify-content is 'normal', so nav icons sit 12px left of the rail centre, while header, search, year, theme and logout buttons are centred. The active item has no brand-tinted pill (background is transparent). Hover background and rounded styles are broken, and the badge dot is placed relative to an unstyled link. RCA: RailTip wraps the NavLink in <TooltipTrigger asChild>. The Radix Slot merges className as [slotClass, childClass].filter(Boolean).join(' '), which turns NavLink's function className into a string. Expanded mode has no tooltip wrapper, so it is fine.

issues: The rail search icon only expands the sidebar. It does not focus sidebar-search afterwards, so the user has to click again.

If a search query is typed and then the sidebar is collapsed, the rail still shows only the filtered results (e.g. only nav-students), and there is no visible search box to explain why. Clear the query when collapsing, or ignore it in rail mode.
The tenant BrandMark logo in the sidebar header is almost invisible in dark mode: a dark logo on a dark tile.
The 'Super Admin' role text in brand red on the dark profile card has low contrast.
The Academic Year selector now appears twice: in the sidebar under search, and in the topbar. Consider hiding the topbar one on md+ screens.

action_items: Fix the rail link classes in AppShell.jsx renderLink. Option 1: give NavLink a plain string className computed with useLocation/matchPath. Option 2: wrap the NavLink in a <span className="flex justify-center"> as the TooltipTrigger asChild child, so Slot merges onto the span and not onto the NavLink function className. Then verify the rail icons are centred and the active pill shows.
Optional: when rail-search expands the sidebar, focus the search input. Also clear the query when collapsing.
Optional: improve BrandMark visibility and role-text contrast in dark mode, and remove the duplicate academic-year selector from the topbar on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: AppShell.jsx is 625 lines. Consider moving SidebarContent, Avatar and RailTip into components/Sidebar.jsx.
RailTip with asChild must never wrap a component whose className is a function (NavLink). This is the root cause of the rail bug.
The 2x 401 console errors seen on every login are pre-login session probes, not caused by the sidebar.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (1 HIGH visual bug in the rail; all functional flows pass)

seed_data_creation: None. Badges were tested by mocking /api/messages/unread-count via page.route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On mobile, admin login shows a 'Set a 4-digit PIN' dialog. Click the text 'Skip for now', then product-tour-skip. The owner goes to /platform, which has no desktop-sidebar. Rail centring check: compare each nav svg centre with the desktop-sidebar centre; before the fix the offset was -12px and buttons were 0px. localStorage sidebarRail was left at '0'.
rca of the issue: Radix Slot (TooltipTrigger asChild) mergeProps joins className values as strings. NavLink receives a function className, which gets stringified, so the className callback never runs in rail mode. Reproduce: collapse the sidebar, then inspect [data-testid=nav-overview].className, which starts with '({ isActive }) =>'.
